Chapter 435: Chapter 9: The Unimaginable Gourd (Please Subscribe)

“`

“Consciousness can’t even penetrate it, this gourd…”

“`

Lin Yuan’s expression turned slightly serious as he carefully examined the palm-sized gray gourd.

In the vast cosmos, many substances are extremely hard,

very difficult to destroy, yet few can block the penetration of an evolver’s conscious power.

...

Conscious power is even more difficult to detect than the power of the world or the power of the soul,

as it is a derivative of Spirit Will.

With Lin Yuan’s current Mental Will Index, unless it’s a treasure or rare treasure of the Eighth Layer,

he could see through most of it, if not in minute detail.

“An Eighth Layer treasure or rare treasure?”

Lin Yuan touched the surface of the gray gourd, cold and with almost no resistance, as if it were the texture of some high-end alloy.

“What exactly formed this?”

For a moment, Lin Yuan couldn’t determine whether the gray gourd was artificially made or had always been this way.

“Goddess of Wisdom, do you know what this gourd is?”

After pondering for a while, Lin Yuan decisively connected to the Goddess of Wisdom.

As one of the three ultimate intelligence Goddesses of human civilization, the Goddess of Wisdom has almost all known materials of humanity recorded.

Be it treasures or rare treasures.

As long as they had been uploaded by human evolvers, they would be documented by the Goddess of Wisdom.

Therefore,

one consults the Goddess when in doubt.

This is not just an empty saying in human civilization.

“Respected Galaxy Master, there is nothing similar to this object in the database…”

The solemn and cool voice of the Goddess of Wisdom came through.

“Nothing similar?”

Lin Yuan was slightly startled.

The Goddess of Wisdom had only performed a preliminary scan, and to conduct a more in-depth ‘identification,’ it would be necessary to send the gray gourd to the Central Star Domain.

Lin Yuan’s Spirit Will-power could not penetrate the gourd, but that did not mean human civilization could not manage.

However—

Even with just a preliminary scan, to get the Goddess of Wisdom to give a result of no similarity was extremely rare.

In more than two million years of the Starry Sea Era, had the countless evolvers of human civilization never seen anything?

Not to say something exactly like the gray gourd, but at least there should be many roughly similar things, right?

But the result given by the Goddess of Wisdom was none.

“Treasure, this must be a treasure.”

Lin Yuan constricted his thoughts and looked at the gray gourd in front of him.

A normal item, even if never seen by the Goddess of Wisdom, would definitely have some similar information.

“I got this gray gourd from an Alien Lone Walker?”

Lin Yuan began to recall that the owner of the gray gourd was indeed a Seventh Rank Different Species Lone Walker.

Compared to special life forms, Different Species Lone Walkers preferred roaming the universe, and after a long time, they generally collected many bizarre items.

This gray gourd, which was kept in that Seventh Rank Different Species Lone Walker’s space ring along with other objects of dubious provenance, was one such item.

Clearly.

The Seventh Rank Different Species Lone Walker had not discovered anything special about the gray gourd.

Perhaps the other party only sensed that the gray gourd was extremely hard and could block the penetration of the will.

Those Different Species Lone Walkers did not have the ‘identification’ methods of the Goddess of Wisdom.

In the vastness of the universe, the emergence of one particularly hard object is not unusual.

Initially, Lin Yuan did not pay much attention to the gray gourd, thinking that it might be worth a few Cubic Universe Crystals?

“Hard?”

“Let’s see just how hard you are.”

Lin Yuan gripped the gray gourd and began to squeeze with force.

Hum.

Terrible force began to subtly affect the surrounding void.

It should be known that the Physical Body Divine Ability Lin Yuan had awakened was the ‘Mountain Lifting,’ known as a Divine Skill of power.

With Lin Yuan’s Eighth Stage Martial Arts physical body, under the enhancement of the Divine Ability ‘Mountain Lifting,’ he could easily crush a higher life planet.

A regular Eighth Rank evolver wouldn’t be able to withstand such a squeeze.

This was the suppression brought by absolute power. One of the nine Supreme Beings of Human Civilization was the ultimate in the Dao of the Rule of Power. With a mere gesture, pure force could tear apart millions of miles of the Main World’s space.

That ultimate Supreme Being of power, along with Xia Qin Supreme Being, was known as one of the two strongest Supreme Beings in terms of killing power in the Human Civilization Alliance.

“Hmm?”

“Still blocked it?”

After squeezing with full strength for a short while, Lin Yuan released his hand and noticed not even a slight mark had been left on the gray gourd; his expression changed once again.

Even the piece of Eighth Layer armor he wore would show some mark under such force.

And that was Eighth Layer armor designed for defense, but this gray gourd did not appear to be related to defense, yet its sturdiness exceeded even the Eighth Layer armor?

“I don’t believe it.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts flickered.

Carrying the gray gourd, he arrived in his Inner World.

Whirl.

The Inner World now extended across more than seven hundred thousand miles, having integrated three cosmic rare treasures, and coupled with Lin Yuan’s own comprehension of the laws, was becoming ever closer to the real world.

“Go.”

With a toss of the gray gourd from his hand,

the power of the World within the Inner World surged tumultuously, sweeping the gray gourd away.

The terrifying world power seemed as if to recreate heaven and earth, attacking the gray gourd from all angles.

However.

No matter how Lin Yuan stimulated the world power,

the gray gourd remained unmoved, floating buoyantly under the immense suppression of the world force.

“Even the power of the World can’t do anything to it?”

Lin Yuan’s face grew solemn. In his Inner World, he could exert almost as much strength as an invincible Eighth Rank who mastered a certain Cosmic Force.

Yet even so,

he still could not shake the gray gourd.

Lin Yuan even had the sensation that even if he became an invincible Eighth Rank and advanced to Ninth Rank,

he still would not be able to affect this gray gourd.
